Name: (BAGI) Vanilla-Style Icons for Lumisteria Flowers and Crops
Author: Doragoun
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7110][img]https://i.imgur.com/OXmorpf.png[/img]

﻿Lumisteria Flowers and Crops[/url] is a mainstay when it comes to modded flowers (especially ones that grow in winter!), but there was no vanilla-style BAGI pack for it... until now. This mod adds unique sprites for all artisan goods related to the added crops: juice and pickles made from the two veggies as well honey and mead made from its flowers. Additionally, there are two different styles of mead bottles to choose from: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13805]Teyla[/url]'s and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11752]Tithrandel[/url]'s.

The process to switch between the different styles of mead bottles is a little more complicated than I'd like, but it's still fairly easy:
First, open the data.json in the "[BAGI] Quaint Living Mead" folder using any text editor. Once you've opened the file, find the line that reads [code]"Mead": "assets/Lumisteria Mead 1.png"
[/code]and simply replace the 1 with a 2. Number 1 corresponds to the Teyla-style bottles, 2 to the Tithrandel-style bottles. Save the edit and you're done.

Alternatively, you can simply rename the two files in the assets folder of the meads part of the mod. If you don't edit the data.json as described above, the mod will look for whatever files is named "Quaint Living Mead 1" and use that in-game. I think you can figure the rest out on your own. ^^

If you have any questions or problems, please leave a comment and I'll do my best to help out!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/7sjEGHy.png[/img]

Couldn't be easier - first, make sure you have all the prerequisites installed:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]BAGI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://github.com/daleao/bagi-meads]BAGI's Mead Add-On[/url]﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7110]Lumisteria Flowers and Crops [/url]﻿(without it, you wouldn't be here, right?)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Meads[/url]﻿ or something similar that allows the game to remember which honey mead is made from
[/list]
Once you've done that, download this mod, unizp it in your mods folder and you're already done. If you want to uninstall the mod, simply delete the files again.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/1dsrOor.png[/img]

[list]
[*]The SDV Discord for being an amazing community as usual
[*]Lumisteria for allowing me to make this BAGI pack in the first place
[*]Teyla and Tithrandel for making the mead bottles I used as a template
[*]CatCattyCat and DaLion for creating BAGI and its mead add-on respectively
[/list]
